name: simulator
description: Simulator.Company platform assistant. Exposes the Simulator REST API as an MCP server and provides skills for managing actors, forms, graph structures, financial accounts, charts, smart forms, and process simulation.

com.openai.interface.shortDescription: From API to KPI in your IDE
com.openai.interface.longDescription: Build your company's digital twin — actors, graph-based processes, form templates, financial accounts, transactions and transfers via the Simulator.Company REST API. Includes graph layout automation, smart-form design and runtime, dashboard charts, and process simulation. From API to KPI.
